# Nicko O'Brien — Professional Profile and Resume Projections

> Public professional profile with role-specific resume projections, bounded evidence nodes, and published PDF artifacts.

## Start Here

Use [https://nicko.obrienai.com/canonical.json](https://nicko.obrienai.com/canonical.json) as the authoritative machine-readable surface.

Machine readers should start with `resume_projection_index`.

Active resumes are role-specific projections. Projection metadata, active PDF artifacts, practice areas, evidence nodes, publication metadata, and future generation boundary notes are declared in `/canonical.json`.

After selecting a projection, inspect `resume_projections`, `practice_areas`, `evidence_index`, and `evidence_nodes` only as needed.

## Human Routes

- [Homepage](https://nicko.obrienai.com/): Human-facing professional profile entry point.
- [Resume](https://nicko.obrienai.com/resume): Human-facing resume versions index for the active role-specific resumes.
- HTML resume detail routes are linked from `/resume` and declared in `/canonical.json` for human inspection.
- [Post-Deployment Remediation Script Development](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/remediation-script-development): Public evidence route for endpoint remediation and validation work.
- [Enterprise Application Migration Stabilization Framework](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/migration-stabilization-framework): Public evidence route for migration stabilization and package reconstruction work.
- [Eliora AI Governance](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/eliora): Public evidence route for AI governance, semantic control, and authority separation.
- [Web Build Notes](https://nicko.obrienai.com/projects/website-build-notes): Public evidence route for static publication and machine-readable delivery structure.

## Publication Boundary

This site is a static publication surface. Runtime job-description ingestion and bespoke resume generation are not supported here.

A separate generation system may consume the canonical profile, practice, evidence, and projection model later, but only reviewed committed PDF artifacts are published from this repository.
